verdict.rationale: Productboard documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.productboard.com. Setup is covered: admins enable MCP per workspace, choose which roles may connect, and users sign in through the browser using OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE. The docs name supported clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Lovable) and list read/write tools for features, initiatives, releases, OKRs and feedback. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You connect your agent to a single address: `https://mcp.productboard.com`. Signing in happens through your browser, using your existing Productboard login.
The Productboard MCP server lets your coding agent read product specs straight from Productboard — and write back to them.
Authenticate MCP (Model Context Protocol) clients using Dynamic Client Registration and the authorization code flow with PKCE. No client secret required.
Turn on Enable MCP for this workspace.

The Productboard MCP server bridges those divides by allowing you to employ the AI tools and agents you’re already using to access and update the product data, specifications, and documents in your Productboard workspace.
